error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the utility portal.

init.title: Cost estimate
init.description: Estimated cost uses the Longmont residential (RE) tiered rate. Tiers reset each billing cycle; enter the day of the month your billing cycle starts (your meter read date).

rates_changed.title: Longmont electricity rates changed
rates_changed.description: The City of Longmont's published residential (RE) rates changed. Estimated costs from {effective} onward now use the new prices. Review them at {url}.

rates_unreadable.title: Longmont rate page could not be read
rates_unreadable.description: The residential rate page at {url} could not be read or validated for {days} consecutive days. Estimated costs keep using the last known rates until it can be read again.
